# Rahul Challa

> Rahul Challa is a software engineer in the San Francisco Bay Area who builds AI and backend systems: LLM inference and routing, reinforcement learning, distributed data pipelines and developer tools. He holds an M.S. in Computer Science from the University of California, Riverside. Website: https://rahulchalla.com

## Current role

- Robotics AI Data & Evaluation Specialist at Google DeepMind (contract via Adecco), Nov 2026 – present. Builds internal operator scripts, UI workflows and telemetry tools (cut manual QA overhead by 15%), debugs terminal-level faults and sensor issues (reduced downtime by 15%), and sustains a 95% data yield across training pipelines with automated session validation and anomaly detection.

## Experience

- Software Engineer, AI & Backend — Saayam for All (Aug 2026 – Nov 2026): Flask backend routing multiple LLMs at 630+ tokens/sec with sub-second latency; sub-500ms PostgreSQL search; telemetry pipeline benchmarking TTFT that cut inference delays by 94%; zero-shot classification for semantic prompt routing.
- Graduate Researcher, Autotuning Framework — University of California, Riverside (Jul 2025 – Mar 2026): sequential reinforcement-learning model reaching 90% parameter-matching accuracy for unknown CPUs; convergence within 0.5% of a 500M+ configuration space using IPC, CPI and cache-level metrics; cross-platform profiler across 30 workloads with prediction error within 5% of ground truth.
- Undergraduate Researcher, ASL Translation System — SOA University (Feb 2024 – Jun 2024): ensemble Random Forest classifier with 98% real-time accuracy; OpenCV pipeline tracking 21 hand landmarks; sub-500ms latency.

## Projects

- [Wildfire Twin](https://github.com/rahul-challa/wild-fire-twin): digital-twin disaster simulation on Kafka, Spark, Apache Sedona, H3, DuckDB and Streamlit; sub-30s SLA at 1K concurrent events; P95 spatial-join latency cut by 91% across 11.5M building footprints.
- [TexMex](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=RahulChalla.texmex): live LaTeX editor for VS Code with 1,200+ users; zero-dependency extension with a fault-tolerant WebSocket collaboration server and sub-100ms preview latency on 10K+ line documents. Source: https://github.com/rahul-challa/TexMex
- [Private Credit Portfolio Engine](https://github.com/rahul-challa/Private-Credit-Portfolio-Engine): Spring Boot and PostgreSQL REST microservices for credit facilities, borrowers and covenants; OAuth2/JWT security; JUnit 5, Mockito and Cucumber tests in CI/CD.
- [Distributed API Rate Limiter](https://github.com/rahul-challa/Gubernator---Distributed-API-Rate-limiter): Go token-bucket rate limiter handling 100K+ requests/sec over gRPC and REST at sub-millisecond latency; cut API abuse by 99%.
